title: Darth Maul
description: Darth Maul was the deadly apprentice of the Sith Lord Darth Sidious, eager to reveal himself to the Jedi so the Sith could get their revenge on them. Athletic and agile, Maul wielded a red double-bladed Lightsaber and fought with a zeal and ferocity that could put even a Jedi Master off their guard. On Naboo, he fought Qui-Gon Jinn and his apprentice and was able to eliminate Jinn in their duel. In response, Obi-Wan Kenobi bisected the Sith apprentice. But that wasn't the end of his journey...
